purpose: Existing gates (scripts/critic_gate.py problems, scripts/daily_production.py review_problems, scripts/opening_compare.py) read these exact fields from the reviewer's JSON. Return ONE JSON object per treatment (opening-a-critic and opening-b-critic) that carries your independent judgment in these fields and echoes the bindings below. The bindings are computed by the existing repository code from the current boards because a Read-only reviewer can't hash. They bind your review to the current bytes and approve nothing. A fail verdict is returned as a real fail.

required_fields.reviewer_identity: your identity string, distinct from the director claude-sonnet-5-5
required_fields.reviewed_at: UTC ISO time; if you have no clock write the harness-visible time from the packet or say unknown
required_fields.verdict: pass or revise, your own judgment
required_fields.weakest_frame: time range and what is weakest
required_fields.action_reviews: [] unless the board declares action proposals
required_fields.per_defect: object mapping each earlier finding id to resolved or unresolved

shape_example_from_prior_valid_review: out/dispatch/retained-failures/critic-5-opening-reviews/opening-a-critic.json (shape only; do not copy its verdicts or text)
